instruction.text: The UK is in Europe. Can you find Europe on the map?
Now let’s zoom in on Europe. Can you find the UK on the map?

hint.text: A short ferry ride can take you from our island to mainland Europe!

instruction.text: Finally, we can zoom in on the UK. Answer the questions using the map.

atoms.a: How many countries are in the UK?

feedback.end: Although the UK itself is a country, it is made up of four smaller countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

atoms.a: Which country in the UK is the biggest?
Which country in the UK is on a separate island?

instruction.text: Can you remember where Scotland is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: It can get very cold in Scotland because it is high up in the north.

instruction.text: Can you remember where England is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: England is the biggest UK country.

instruction.text: Can you remember where Wales is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: Wales is a small country connected to England by land.

instruction.text: Can you remember where Northern Ireland is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: Northern Ireland is on a separate island to the other countries.
